content_sections.heading: About CUJ
content_sections.text: The Central University of Jharkhand is a central university established by an Act of Parliament of India in 2009. Its campus is at Village Cheri-Manatu, Kanke, Ranchi, Jharkhand. This engagement is for the university's Department of English Studies.

content_sections.heading: CUJ Assistant Professor Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet condition A or condition B below, and must also have the required specialisation. A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian university, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. In addition, candidates must have cleared NET conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC such as SLET/SET. Candidates who hold, or have held, a Ph.D. awarded under the UGC (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments are exempt from NET/SLET/SET. Candidates who registered for a Ph.D. before 11 July 2009 are also exempt from NET/SLET/SET, provided all of these conditions are met: The Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the university concerned must certify that these conditions are met. NET/SLET/SET is also not required for Master's programmes in disciplines where the UGC, CSIR or a similar accredited test does not conduct NET/SLET/SET. A Ph.D. from a foreign university or institution that has ranked among the top 500 in the world at any time in one of these rankings: QS (Quacquarelli Symonds), the Times Higher Education (THE), or the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of Shanghai Jiao Tong University. NET or Ph.D. in English Master's degree in English, English Literature, Linguistics, Film Studies, English Language & Literature, Communicative English or Translation Studies SC, ST, Differently-abled (physically and visually differently-abled) and OBC (non-creamy layer) candidates may get a 5% relaxation in marks at Graduate and Master's level. The relaxation applies to the qualifying marks only, without any grace marks. Ph.D. holders who completed their Master's degree before 19 September 1991 may get a 5% relaxation, from 55% to 50%. A grade that a recognised university treats as equivalent to 55% is also accepted. Check the official notification for the full discipline-specific eligibility for this post.

content_sections.heading: Salary and Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely temporary. The consolidated remuneration is Rs. 57,700/- (Rupees fifty seven thousand seven hundred only) a month. The engaged candidate does not get residential accommodation, official transport, leave encashment or any other allowance or facility that regular employees receive. The candidate gets 8 days of leave a year on a pro-rata basis. The engagement is initially for one semester, or as the university requires. It may be extended depending on the university's needs and the incumbent's performance.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: The interview date may change. Any change will be announced on the university website. The interview may also run into the next day, so candidates should come prepared for that.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is by walk-in interview, which is open only to candidates who have registered online. No TA/DA or accommodation is provided for attending the interview. CUJ may cancel or modify the interview of any department without giving a reason.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CUJ Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Register through the online registration form (Google Form) by 5.00 p.m. on 3 November 2026. Download the application form from the university website, www.cuj.ac.in , and fill it in. Report to the venue between 9.30 a.m. and 10.30 a.m. on 5 November 2026, carrying the documents listed below. The filled-in application form Bio-data All original documents, plus a self-attested photocopy of each Two colour photographs Ph.D. holders under the 2009/2016 UGC Regulations: a certificate from the awarding university in the Annexure-I format Candidates who registered for a Ph.D. before 11 July 2009: a certificate in the Annexure-II format SC/ST candidates: a caste certificate in the Annexure-III format. OBC candidates: a certificate in the Annexure-IV format. Candidates in the PH category: a medical certificate from the competent authority OBC candidates must bring a valid caste certificate for the current financial year in the Government of India proforma. It must state that they do not belong to the creamy layer under DoPT OM No. 36012/22/93-Estt. (SCT) dated 08.09.1993. Details are on www.ncbc.nic.in . Without this certificate, a candidate will not be allowed to attend the interview. The caste name, including its spelling, must match the Central Government list exactly. A certificate with any variation will not be accepted. An OBC claim is judged by the State to which the candidate's father originally belongs.

content_sections.heading: Other Conditions
content_sections.text: If a mistake in the selection process comes to light at any stage, even after the engagement letter is issued or after joining, the university may modify, withdraw or cancel any communication to the candidate. Any legal dispute falls only under the jurisdiction of the Courts of Ranchi. Any corrigendum or addendum will be published only on the university website. Queries can be sent to [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. Can I attend the CUJ walk-in interview without registering online?
faq.answer: No. The interview is held only for candidates who have registered through the online form, and registration closes at 5.00 p.m. on 3 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What time should I reach the venue on 5 November 2026?
faq.answer: Reporting is between 9.30 a.m. and 10.30 a.m., and interviews begin at 10.30 a.m. The interview may continue into the next day.

faq.question: Q3. Which Master's subjects are accepted for this English post?
faq.answer: English, English Literature, Linguistics, Film Studies, English Language & Literature, Communicative English and Translation Studies.

faq.question: Q4. Do I need NET if I have a Ph.D.?
faq.answer: No, if your Ph.D. was awarded under the UGC Regulations of 2009 or 2016. You will need to bring a certificate in the Annexure-I format from your university.

faq.question: Q5. How long does the engagement last?
faq.answer: It is initially for one semester, or as the university requires. It may be extended depending on the university's needs and your performance.

faq.question: Q6. What leave and benefits does the post carry?
faq.answer: You get 8 days of leave a year on a pro-rata basis. You do not get residential accommodation, official transport, leave encashment or other allowances paid to regular staff.

faq.question: Q7. Is there a marks relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes. SC, ST, Differently-abled and OBC (non-creamy layer) candidates get a 5% relaxation at Graduate and Master's level. Ph.D. holders who completed their Master's before 19 September 1991 need 50% instead of 55%.

faq.question: Q8. Will CUJ pay travel costs for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA or accommodation will be provided for attending the interview.
